ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_001.source_old: Chieftain, we’ve been standing waist-deep in this mire for hours!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_001.source_new: Chieftain, we’ve been standing waist-deep in this mire for hours!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_002.source_old: Watch your mouth youngblood… the Warchief has honored us with this mission that will lead our clan to glory… and you’re complaining about mosquitos!?
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_002.source_new: Watch your mouth youngblood… the Warchief has honored us with this mission that will lead our clan to glory… and you’re complaining about mosquitos!?

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_003.source_old: Quiet! I see something moving at the landing site.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S001_003.source_new: Quiet! I see something moving at the landing site.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_001.source_old: Horde marauders have landed near our shores! Send word to the capital. They’re here.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_001.source_new: Horde marauders have landed near our shores! Send word to the capital. They’re here.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_002.source_old: It seems to be a scouting force. They’re probably hiding in the mire… no more than a dozen strong, we must slaughter them.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_002.source_new: It seems to be a scouting force. They’re probably hiding in the mire… no more than a dozen strong, we must slaughter them.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_003.source_old: Dammit! Our position has been compromised! There goes our element of surprise…
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_003.source_new: Dammit! Our position has been compromised! There goes our element of surprise…

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_004.source_old: We must recapture those vessels and use them to set up a foothold on the island. When the Warchief arrives, we will need to provide everything that he needs to begin the siege.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_004.source_new: We must recapture those vessels and use them to set up a foothold on the island. When the Warchief arrives, we  will need to provide everything that he needs to begin the siege.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_005.source_old: Send a signal to our ships! We will prepare a counter-surprise for these humans.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S002_005.source_new: Send a signal to our ships! We will prepare a counter-surprise for these humans.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S003_001.source_old: Look! More orcs. Our intelligence was right...
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S003_001.source_new: Look! More orcs. Our intelligence was right...

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S003_002.source_old: Ha! I heard that you wanted to slaughter us, human weaklings! Come then! Show me your strength! Ha-ha-ha!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S003_002.source_new: Ha! I heard that you wanted to slaughter us, human weaklings! Come then! Show me your strength! Ha-ha-ha!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_001.source_old: There, a goldmine! This will be a perfect spot for our forward camp. Those pesky humans have fortified their position around it, however…
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_001.source_new: There, a goldmine! This will be a perfect spot for our forward camp. Those pesky humans have fortified their position around it, however…

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_002.source_old: Where’s the problem. Utok? More bodies for me! “smirk”
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_002.source_new: Where’s the problem. Utok? More bodies for me!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_003.source_old: “silently” I really miss working with Rend… this brother of his is more skull than brain…
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S004_003.source_new: I really miss working with Rend… this brother of his is more skull than brain…

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_001.source_old: Have you ever beheld such a sight, my brother? Never in the history of our kingdom have we witnessed such tides of doom approaching our shores.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_001.source_new: Have you ever beheld such a sight, my brother? Never in the history of our kingdom have we witnessed such tides of doom approaching our shores..

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_002.source_old: Come what may, Liam, we are the sons of Arathor… war is in our blood, it is what we do best. Where’s your son, Danath?
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_002.source_new: Come what may, Liam, we are the sons of Arathor… war is in our blood, it is what we do best. Where’s your son, Danath?

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_003.source_old: He was recalled by Anduin Lothar to help quell the Horde’s forward war-parties after Hillsbrad was destroyed. I wish he was here…
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_003.source_new: He was recalled by Anduin Lothar to help quell the Horde’s forward war-parties after Hillsbrad was destroyed. I wish he was here…

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_004.source_old: Steel your heart, my brother, Stromgarde has never fallen to any enemy. The trolls tried their luck and failed, their warbands crushed into dust beneath these very walls… this ‘Horde’ will be no different…
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S005_004.source_new: Steel your heart, my brother, Stromgarde has never fallen to any enemy. The trolls tried their luck and failed, their warbands crushed into dust beneath these very walls… this ‘Horde’ will be no different…

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_001.source_old: Throm'ka, Warchief! The foothold you requested is ready. The pathetic humans didn’t stand a chance against us!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_001.source_new: Throm'ka, Warchief! The foothold you requested is ready. The pathetic humans didn’t stand a chance against us!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_003.source_old: Good job… Maim. Zuluhed reports that you are not as useless as I thought after your failure at Dun Modr. You are passionate and brave, but you should remember that fortune is not infinite.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_003.source_new: Good job… Maim. Zuluhed reports that you are not as useless as I thought after your failure at Dun Modr. You are passionate and brave, but you should remember that fortune is not infinite.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_004.source_old: And you, Utok. Accurate and thoughtful, rare qualities for an orc. You are in good company with the Blackhands. The war goes well when every soldier knows their place.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_004.source_new: And you, Utok. Accurate and thoughtful, rare qualities for an orc. You are in good company with the Blackhands. The war goes well when every soldier knows their place.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_005.source_old: Thank you, Warchief, it’s a great honor for me to serve you and the Horde.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_005.source_new: Thank you, Warchief, it’s a great honor for me to serve you and the Horde.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_006.source_old: Cho'gall reports that the Khaz Modan Refineries are well maintained and fulfilling their quotas. The Horde will now have more than enough oil to mount a fierce campaign in the lands far to the north.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_006.source_new: Cho'gall reports that the Khaz Modan Refineries are well maintained and fulfilling their quotas. The Horde will now have more than enough oil to mount a fierce campaign in the lands far to the north.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_007.source_old: As a gesture of his gratitude for keeping him safe in the wetlands, Cho’gall has sent his ogres to aid us here.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_007.source_new: As a gesture of his gratitude for keeping him safe in the wetlands, Cho’gall has sent his ogres to aid us here.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_008.source_old: Only the troublesome humans of Stromgarde remain to be dealt with before sending the Horde on its next sojourn.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_008.source_new: Only the troublesome humans of Stromgarde remain to be dealt with before sending the Horde on its next sojourn.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_009.source_old: Our forces are ready to crush them, Warchief.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_009.source_new: Our forces are ready to crush them, Warchief.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_010.source_old: Then it’s time to lay waste to their capital. Stromgarde sought to halt our advance… and now they shall reap the rewards… blood and death!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_010.source_new: Then it’s time to lay waste to their capital. Stromgarde sought to halt our advance… and now they shall reap the rewards… blood and death!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_011.source_old: Warriors! Not since Stormwind have we faced such formidable defenses. The walls of Stromgarde are strong and its people seasoned fighters… hardened by centuries of war against our Amani allies.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_011.source_new: Warriors! Not since Stormwind have we faced such formidable defenses. The walls of Stromgarde are strong and its people seasoned fighters… hardened by centuries of war against our Amani allies.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_012.source_old: But nothing, neither walls or experience, will save them from our war machine today! Decimate their walls! Slaughter their people! Lok'tar ogar! For the Horde!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S006_012.source_new: But nothing, neither walls or experience, will save them from our war machine today! Decimate their walls! Slaughter their people! Lok'tar ogar! For the Horde!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S007_001.source_old: Warchief! Stromgarde has a strong fleet and our siege will be hindered if we do not destroy their oil production and supply lines!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S007_001.source_new: Warchief! Stromgarde has a strong fleet and our siege will be hindered if we do not destroy their oil production and supply lines!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S007_002.source_old: Then we destroy their rigs and claim them as our own!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S007_002.source_new: Then we destroy their rigs and claim them as our own!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S008_001.source_old: “smirks” The Horde’s supremacy over the seas is assured!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S008_001.source_new: The Horde’s supremacy over the seas is assured!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_001.source_old: This city was once the very heart of human civilization, orc… you will not desecrate it!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_001.source_new: This city was once the very heart of human civilization, orc… you will not desecrate it!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_002.source_old: You are the leader of this fortress. Killing you will bring me great honor, human.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_002.source_new: You are the leader of this fortress. Killing you will bring me great honor, human.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_003.source_old: We will see about that, greenskin. My blade has slain countless brutes like you, and I have yet to meet one that would pose a challenge.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S009_003.source_new: We will see about that, greenskin. My blade has slain countless brutes like you, and I have yet to meet one that would pose a challenge.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S010_001.source_old: Pillage the city! Burn it to the ground!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S010_001.source_new: Pillage the city! Burn it to the ground!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_001.source_old: Build more catapults! We must destroy the inner walls to get into the city!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_001.source_new: Build more catapults! We must destroy the inner walls to get into the city!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_002.source_old: Fight to the last man! Stromgarde must not fall!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_002.source_new: Fight to the last man! Stromgarde must not fall!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_003.source_old: Children of Stromgarde! This is your home, your lands! The Horde has come to destroy everything that is dear to you! Defend your honor! Defend your home!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S011_003.source_new: Children of Stromgarde! This is your home, your lands! The Horde has come to destroy everything that is dear to you! Defend your honor! Defend your home!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S012_001.source_old: They’ve destroyed the lower city and broken through! Men! Defend your homes at all costs!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S012_001.source_new: They’ve destroyed the lower city and broken through! Men! Defend your homes at all costs!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S012_002.source_old: Utok! Maim! At my side at once! The city is on the brink of falling! Push forward!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S012_002.source_new: Utok! Maim! At my side at once! The city is on the brink of falling! Push forward!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_001.source_old: Brother! The city has fallen. The Horde are at the gates of our keep!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_001.source_new: Brother! The city has fallen. The Horde are at the gates of our keep!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_002.source_old: We will not falter. This is our home. We cannot abandon it!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_002.source_new: We will not falter. This is our home. We cannot abandon it!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_003.source_old: You are our King. Your life is far more important than mine. House Trollbane survives through you, my brother. You must retreat to Lordaeron.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_003.source_new: You are our King. Your life is far more important than mine. House Trollbane survives through you, my brother. You must retreat to Lordaeron.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_004.source_old: I will not be known as the king who ran, Liam! Besides… you are my brother. I will not allow you to perish like this!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_004.source_new: I will not be known as the king who ran, Liam! Besides… you are my brother. I will not allow you to perish like this!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_005.source_old: No. Terenas is your friend. He will aid you. And Anduin Lothar will stand by your side when the time to avenge me comes. Live today and fight tomorrow… live, so that Stromgarde may live. The city can be rebuilt. And our family will endure.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_005.source_new: No. Terenas is your friend. He will aid you. And Anduin Lothar will stand by your side when the time to avenge me comes. Live today and fight tomorrow… live, so that Stromgarde may live. The city can be rebuilt. And our family will endure.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_006.source_old: I will avenge you brother. I swear it!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_006.source_new: I will avenge you brother. I swear it!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_007.source_old: Tell Danath that I love him… and to remember me. Tell him that I have always been proud that he is my son. Now go! I will cover your retreat!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S013_007.source_new: Tell Danath that I love him… and to remember me. Tell him that I have always been proud that he is my son. Now go! I will cover your retreat!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_001.source_old: *broken common* You. Not king. King is coward. Ran away.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_001.source_new: You. Not king. King is coward. Ran away.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_002.source_old: No! He did not run. His actions have saved a bloodline… and robbed you of the price you sought! Now face me!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_002.source_new: No! He did not run. His actions have saved a bloodline… and robbed you of the price you sought! Now face me!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_003.source_old: *broken common* Brave warrior you are. But futile attempt!
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S014_003.source_new: Brave warrior you are. But futile attempt!

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_001.source_old: After the gruesome battle ended, Orgrim Doomhammer gathered his lieutenants in Stromgarde's main square, covered with the corpses of fallen humans....
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_001.source_new: After the gruesome battle ended, Orgrim Doomhammer gathered his lieutenants in Stromgarde's main square, covered with the corpses of fallen humans....

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_002.source_old: The city is taken, Warchief. Utterly destroyed by your might. It is a great honor to fight beside you.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_002.source_new: The city is taken, Warchief. Utterly destroyed by your might. It is a great honor to fight beside you.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_003.source_old: You honor me with your flattery, young Utok. One day you will rise to be one my most trusted warriors.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_003.source_new: You honor me with your flattery, young Utok. One day you will rise to be one my most trusted warriors.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_004.source_old: I will not fail you, Warchief. This was a long siege. By your leave, our warriors deserve rest and a feast.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_004.source_new: I will not fail you, Warchief. This was a long siege. By your leave, our warriors deserve rest and a feast.

ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_005.source_old: That they do! But we must not linger here too long. That coward king will surely warn his allies about what happened here. We must move north soon.
ToD_A02_M07_VO_S015_005.source_new: That they do! But we must not linger here too long. That coward king will surely warn his allies about what happened here. We must move north soon.
